column1: # TCP listener allowlist (#8926). Only trusty-console may listen on TCP (ADR-0032), plus the RFC 8252 OAuth loopback (owner ruling 135).
# One file, two readers:
#   scripts/check_no_tcp_listeners.sh  source lint: every TCP bind/listen site in
#                                      crates/**/*.rs must sit under a `paths` entry.
#   tm doctor, row `tcp_listeners`     live probe (include_str!): a trusty-* process
#                                      listening on TCP must be named in `processes`.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   kind       permanent    the console (ADR-0032) and the gworkspace OAuth loopback
#                           (owner ruling 135). Source OK; live listener OK.
#              temporary    a daemon still being migrated. Source OK; live listener WARNs.
#              source-only  a bind in source that is not a resident daemon. Source OK;
#                           the doctor treats any live listener from it as FAIL.
#   crate      the crate that owns the listener.
#   processes  comma-separated executable basenames the doctor matches; `-` for source-only.
#   paths      comma-separated repo-relative files, or directories ending in `/`, the lint
#              excuses. A path that excuses no site fails the lint: delete it with the bind.
#   issue      ADR-NNNN or ruling-NNN (an owner ruling) for permanent; #N (an open issue) otherwise.
#   reason     free text.
# Removing a temporary row: the PR that removes the bind deletes its whole line.
